promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Image 1: style authority
Image 2: Image 2: scale only

Image 1 is the style authority: the white laser turret head of a ground vehicle, a circular domed shell. Keep its language: a round white ceramic shell with panel seams, graphite trim and a cool cyan light. Image 2 is a scale reference only.
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-source concept for a top-down tactical-game sprite: a MEDIUM TURRET BASE, the round housing a laser gun is mounted in, with no gun.
Primary request: a compact circular turret housing seen from above, about two thirds the width of Image 1: a smooth domed white ceramic shell with a graphite collar ring at its edge, two small sensor blocks on its sides, panel seams and a cyan light, and at the top (north) a short flat gun port, a squared notch with a dark recessed cradle where a gun barrel exits. The centre of the dome has a flat seat where the gun's rear mount sits. Nothing sits in the port: no barrel, no gun, no lens. Symmetrical left to right.
Avoid: any gun, barrel, lens, blue orb, olive-drab paint, red, perspective, side view, text.

True isolation: exactly one object centred in a square canvas on a flat featureless pure white plate (no gradient, shadow, halo, ground, border, text or labels); the object fills about 90 percent of the canvas. Strict 90-degree zenith orthographic top-down view, lighting from the upper left, crisp painted game-sprite finish with fine surface noise, panel seams, fasteners and restrained wear, like Image 1.
agentMessages: I’ll generate one turret-base concept using Image 1’s white ceramic, graphite, and cyan styling.
